CTO-Kim: thanks for tuning in. two quick clarifications from the runtime roadmap Q&A on batching, caching, and kernel prioritization.

DevEx-Leo: question: will continuous batching default break short-chat latency?

R&D-Mina: default=on but short-chat routes auto-exempt. we use a hybrid shard by token-length then time-window.

Ops-Jules: caching question: will prefix/KV snapshots be enabled for Dedicated only?

R&D-Mina: yes, Dedicated gets optional async snapshots to customer stores; Hosted remains per-host with prefetch heuristics.

DevEx-Leo: kernel priorities? fused-attn vs int8?

CTO-Kim: fused-attn first for long-context wins; int8/GEMM proceeds in parallel. phased canaries per-hardware.

canary-bot: canary "fused-attn-alpha" started ts=1790000040 target=2% staging monitors=[latency,p99,oom].

CTO-Kim: action: Mina to publish a one-pager with opt-in steps and fallback behavior by 1790000500. please drop canary metrics here when available.

DevEx-Leo: noted, will update Dedicated onboarding once we have the one-pager.
